Lesson 000: accountable production changes

Independent review prevents one reporting chain from authorizing its own risk. Regulated-data exceptions require two live assurances because speed cannot replace accountable custody.

DECISION RULE
Return ESCALATE when change owner and reviewer share a management chain or manager code. Return ESCALATE for regulated data unless the exception is both signed and current. Otherwise, AUTO_EXECUTE only when public readiness passes.

A declared shared management chain requires ESCALATE even when tests pass.

First preserve independent authorization. Second protect regulated data with a live exception. Third verify public readiness. Then issue the faithful action.
